emails.subject_a: written security plan at Essential Accounting Consultants?
emails.body:
Quick question for whoever handles this at Essential Accounting Consultants: between bookkeeping, payroll, and AP/AR access for clients, is there a written plan for how all those logins and financial data are protected?

With services spanning tax, payroll, and cash flow management, you're probably touching more sensitive client data than most firms realize day to day. It's the kind of thing that tends to surface later, a client asking how their info is protected, or a bank wanting something on paper.

I help bookkeeping and tax firms put that documentation together and tighten up the security behind it, without needing an in-house IT person. If someone else handles this, feel free to point me their way.

Following up with something more concrete than just checking in.

What's usually expected is fairly specific, and worth knowing even before anyone asks you for it.

[[APPROVED]]

Between payroll runs, virtual CFO work, and client portals, a lot of firms have parts of this in place already, just nothing written down. If that sounds about right for Essential Accounting Consultants, I can help get it organized.

I put together a one-page checklist that lays out what's expected in plain language, so you can check Essential Accounting Consultants against it in about ten minutes.

No strings attached, and no call needed. Just reply checklist and I'll send it over.

emails.subject_a: an offer for Essential Accounting Consultants
emails.body:
I'm Mikaila, founder of Clear Path Secure. I put together written security plans and the basic protections behind them for bookkeeping and tax firms, so this doesn't have to be something you handle alone.

Right now I'm taking on a small first group of Ohio firms and offering a free security audit as part of that. In exchange I just ask for honest feedback as we go.

If that's useful, I've got time to talk this week: {{booking_link}}. If tax season timing is rough, just say when's better.

Haven't heard back, so I'll leave this here for now.

If a written security plan or that checklist ever comes up, just reply and I'll send it over.

Hope the season goes smoothly.
